description:
Jiang Beiran's journey to the Xuanlong Continent began in tragedy. He had finally gotten the system, but he had not anticipated it having its own rhythm. As a result, Jiang Beiran chose Gou, avoiding all opportunities to brag and living in quiet. However, reality prevents him from salting a fish; even if he merely displays his might, he has established himself as a mystery powerhouse in the< eyes of all, and he has attracted people wanting a piece of it.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
